title: Concept: Smarty template error returned to a client
description: A Smarty template error with its file and line in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The engine name and template path disclose the stack behind the page, which is useful for shaping a template injection attempt.
applicability: Deployments that render a Smarty template error with its file and line into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The engine name and template path disclose the stack behind the page, which is useful for shaping a template injection attempt.
